description: Bounded task and approval context retention: synthetic development trial, not a production efficacy measurement.
limitations: Not a fresh holdout or a fully passing replay.
Five instruction mismatches remain, including missing-reference false clear and late-permission missed concerns.
Historical packets and fixture hashes differ; raw pass totals are not matched-case improvement evidence.
The initial context-only CLI invocation failed without producing a report; its results and usage are unknown and are not included in these retained totals.
Host smoke used a local synthetic primary stream and live Jev, not a real spawned subagent or every lifecycle race.
